hero.headline: Hello! I'm Mokshith.
hero.sub_headline: I build distributed systems because I have trust issues with single points of failure. ☁️
hero.mission: Making products that my 7 year old brain thought impossible.

experience.description: Prompt engineering meets financial engineering. I built an AI-powered financial strategist using Django and React, trimming OpenAI context fat to serve responses in under 2 seconds. Containerized the deployment pipeline on AWS because the only thing that should crash is the market, not my servers.

Evicted a legacy monolith and rehoused it in Kubernetes (EKS). Optimized the data layer to slash report generation from a 'grab a coffee' 3 minutes to a 10-second blink. Built a Kafka pipeline to ingest 10,000+ daily telemetry events because I prefer my data streaming, not trickling.

Played referee between frontend and backend payloads. Engineered an automated API contract validation system that slashed staging crashes by 40% effectively writing insurance policies for our own code. Also built Python pipelines to tame chaotic Jenkins logs into readable insights.

projects.title: Custom Scheduling Operator
projects.architecture: Default schedulers are fine but I wanted brilliant. I wrote a custom Go operator using CRDs and admission webhooks to hardwire smarter resource logic directly into the cluster.
projects.impact: Orchestrated a massive fleet of 5,000 pods and cut compute costs by 30 percent. It turns out that playing Tetris with server resources actually pays off!

projects.title: Learning-Based Cache Optimization
projects.concept: Giving cache memory a crystal ball to predict the future.
projects.architecture: I trained a PyTorch sequence model on millions of server requests. It learns complex memory access patterns that standard eviction algorithms completely ignore.
projects.impact: Outperformed traditional cache policies and boosted the hit rate by 12 percent. Who knew that teaching infrastructure to read minds would make it so much faster?

projects.title: Decentralized Key-Value Store
projects.concept: Building a distributed database that thrives in pure chaos.
projects.architecture: I engineered a custom Go gossip protocol talking over gRPC on a Docker swarm. When nodes drop or the network splits, the system simply shrugs and heals itself using CRDTs.
projects.impact: Crushed 15,000 operations per second and recovered from simulated network outages in under 100 milliseconds. Because your storage layer should never need a sick day.
